passages.text: The faithful succeed, not the faithless. The energetic succeed, not the lazy. The mindful succeed, not the unmindful. Those with immersion succeed, not those without immersion. The wise succeed, not the witless.
passages.note: what it takes to succeed: faith, energy, mindfulness, wisdom

passages.text: ‘The aristocrat is best among people who take clan as the standard. But one accomplished in knowledge and conduct is first among gods and humans.’
passages.note: worth comes from conduct, not birth or status
